nodes.label: index.js start()
nodes.desc: Bootstraps Zigbee2MQTT: builds the TypeScript project if needed, runs onboarding, then constructs the Controller and starts it. A watchdog can restart the whole process with exponential backoff.

nodes.label: Controller
nodes.desc: Central orchestrator. Creates EventBus, Zigbee, Mqtt and State, registers all extensions, and owns publishEntityState(), the single choke point through which every MQTT state message flows.

nodes.label: EventBus
nodes.desc: Typed EventEmitter with ~22 named events (deviceMessage, mqttMessage, publishEntityState...). Every cross-component message in Zigbee2MQTT travels through this bus, and listeners are registered per-owner so they can be removed on shutdown.

nodes.label: Zigbee
nodes.desc: Wrapper around the zigbee-herdsman Controller. Translates serial settings (port, baudrate, adapter) into herdsman config and re-emits raw Zigbee frames as typed EventBus events.

nodes.label: Mqtt
nodes.desc: MQTT client (mqtt.js). Registers an LWT on bridge/state, subscribes to the whole base topic, suppresses echo of its own publishes, and republishes retained messages if the broker drops them.

nodes.label: State
nodes.desc: In-memory state cache keyed by entity ID, persisted to state.json every 5 minutes. Lets every publish carry the full merged device state, not just the changed attribute.

nodes.label: Settings
nodes.desc: Reads and writes configuration.yaml, resolves per-device friendly names and options, and migrates old config shapes on startup.

nodes.label: Device
nodes.desc: Model around each zh.Device. resolveDefinition() matches the interviewed device against zigbee-herdsman-converters to find its fromZigbee/toZigbee converter set and exposes.

nodes.label: Receive
nodes.desc: Inbound path: picks matching fromZigbee converters for each incoming frame, post-processes payloads, and applies per-device debounce/throttle before publishing state.

nodes.label: Publish
nodes.desc: Outbound path: parses <base_topic>/<entity>/set|get topics, matches each attribute against toZigbee converters, and writes to Zigbee endpoints (with optimistic state updates).

nodes.label: Bridge
nodes.desc: Exposes control topics: bridge/info, bridge/devices, bridge/logging and a requestLookup table of RPC commands under bridge/request/* (permit_join, device/rename, restart...).

nodes.label: Frontend
nodes.desc: Optional HTTP + WebSocket server (zigbee2mqtt-frontend package). Serves the UI statically and pushes every published state message live over the /api WebSocket.
